facts.claim: (search-result snippet from imslp.org) Canon and Gigue in D major, P.37 is catalogued by IMSLP as a work by Johann Pachelbel.
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) IMSLP lists the Suite No.3 in D major, BWV 1068 as a work by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750).
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) IMSLP lists the chorale 'Jesus bleibet meine Freude' as part of Johann Sebastian Bach's Cantata BWV 147, Herz und Mund und Tat und Leben.
(search-result snippet from britannica.com) Britannica describes Jeremiah Clarke (born c. 1674, London; died 1 December 1707, London) as an English organist and composer, mainly of religious music.
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) IMSLP lists 'Arrival of the Queen of Sheba' as an Act III number in Solomon, HWV 67 by George Frideric Handel.
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) An IMSLP score identifies the Rondeau as from Suite 1, movement 1 of Jean-Joseph Mouret's (1682-1738) Symphonies de Fanfares.
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) IMSLP catalogues Ave Maria, CG 89 under Charles Gounod and states Gounod revised the work into its present form setting the Ave Maria text in 1859.
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) IMSLP catalogues Trumpet Tune in C major, ZT 678 under Henry Purcell, with composition year 1696.
(search-result snippet from imslp.org) An IMSLP score identifies Panis Angelicus by Cesar Franck (1822-1890) as an extract from the Messe solennelle, Op. 12, FWV 61, 1860.
(search-result snippet from hymnary.org) Hymnary.org lists Morning Has Broken with author Eleanor Farjeon (1931), place of origin England.
(search-result snippet from hymnary.org) Hymnary.org lists Morning Has Broken (Eleanor Farjeon, 1881-1965) set to the tune BUNESSAN, arranged by David Evans.
(search-result snippet from hymnary.org) Hymnary.org lists The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want set to the tune CRIMOND, composer Jessie Seymour Irvine (1836-87), arranger David Grant (1833-93).
